payload.name: Date-unconstrained follow-up for dated acceptance queries
payload.description: When a question asks what professional experience or opportunity a person was accepted for on a specific date, and date-filtered retrieval returns no matching memory, apply this before answering no information.
content: When a question asks what a person was accepted for or got on a specific date, do not make all searches use that exact date: the supporting event may be stored with a different date (e.g., the internship or program start date) while the acceptance date is absent from the text.

Run at least one additional search combining the person with opportunity-type and acceptance terms (accepted, admitted, offered, internship) without the date filter, and check whether it returns a matching memory before answering 'no information'.

solves: Questions asking what someone was accepted for or got on a specific date can fail because the supporting memory stores a different date (e.g., internship start date). Future inputs with this dated-acceptance pattern should trigger a date-unconstrained search on the person plus opportunity/acceptance terms before concluding no information. Not applicable when the queried date is itself the event's stored date and no related memory exists.
